name: Kente woven stole
where: Textile shop at Accra Arts Centre
about: Kente is a traditional woven cloth of Ghana. Visitors often buy it as a stole or scarf to show a link to Accra's craft culture.
tip: Check whether the cloth is printed or hand-woven. Hand-woven pieces cost more and look different.

name: Unrefined Ghanaian shea butter
about: This shea butter is made by women producers in Ghana. It is a natural skin and body product from the country.
tip: Check the label for added fragrance if you want a plain, unscented product.

name: Krobo recycled glass beaded bracelet
about: Krobo is a region in Ghana known for recycled glass bead making. These bracelets are made from reused glass, so each piece is different.
tip: Confirm the shop's location before you go, as its handicraft market may move.
